Conservative Kokoro training-data attribution

Kokoro's pinned model card identifies the following datasets among the inputs
to the shared Kokoro model. The nine American English preset embeddings in the
Whisperstream archive do not include a Koniwa or SIWIS preset. This attribution
is nevertheless retained conservatively because the shared model was trained
in part on these datasets. It does not state or imply that Whisperstream
redistributes either source dataset.

Koniwa `tnc`
Title: Koniwa, an open collection of annotated voices in Japanese language
Audio licensor and attribution party: Television Nishinippon (TNC)
Repository maintainer: shirayu and Koniwa contributors
Source: https://github.com/koniwa/koniwa
Source attribution record: https://github.com/koniwa/koniwa/blob/master/data/tnc/README.md
Audio license identified by the source: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/
Original literary texts: public domain, per the source attribution record
Kokoro model-card use: less than one hour of Japanese training audio
Modification statement: Whisperstream does not distribute or modify the
Koniwa recordings. Kokoro's upstream authors used them while training the
shared Kokoro model.

SIWIS
Title: The SIWIS French Speech Synthesis Database, 2016
Creators: Junichi Yamagishi, Pierre-Edouard Honnet, Philip Garner, and
Alexandros Lazaridis
Publisher: University of Edinburgh, School of Informatics, Centre for Speech
Technology Research
Citation: Yamagishi, Junichi; Honnet, Pierre-Edouard; Garner, Philip;
Lazaridis, Alexandros. (2017). The SIWIS French Speech Synthesis Database,
2016 [dataset]. https://doi.org/10.7488/ds/1705
Source: https://datashare.ed.ac.uk/items/1de74991-eede-4b48-8fbe-6c2abaed88d8
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Kokoro model-card use: less than eleven hours of French training audio
Modification statement: Whisperstream does not distribute or modify the SIWIS
recordings. Kokoro's upstream authors used them while training the shared
Kokoro model.

No endorsement by the dataset creators, speakers, publishers, or licensors is
stated or implied.
